title: Prototype rules derived from Design Manual: Barrier Free Access 2008 (2025 Edition)
note: Prototype transcription for engineering demonstration. Always verify against the official document before professional use.

rules.description: A door on an accessible route must have a clear width of at least 800 mm.

source.title: Design Manual: Barrier Free Access 2008 (2025 Edition)
source.note: Threshold manually transcribed for prototype evaluation. The IFC adapter requires an explicit IfcBoolean OnAccessibleRoute/IsOnAccessibleRoute flag and an IfcLengthMeasure ClearOpeningWidth/ClearWidth property; OverallWidth is not treated as clear width.
